selected.assay: bulk liver RNA-seq (DNBSEQ-T7), HISAT2 mm10 + featureCounts Gencode vM25 (S4.5.p1)
selected.sample_inclusion: Paper animals: NC n=13, HFD/HAE/HRE n=8 each (S4.1.1.p1, S2.1.p1); RNA-seq n per group not stated in the text. GEO deposits 3 livers per group (12 samples).
selected.primary_estimand: Effect of aerobic (HAE) and resistance (HRE) exercise on liver gene expression in HFD-fed NAFLD mice, each versus sedentary HFD mice
planned_contrasts: HAE vs HFD (S2.6.p1, Fig. 6C; paper: 1,450 DEGs) - primary exercise contrast
HRE vs HFD (S2.6.p1, Fig. 6D; paper: 171 DEGs) - primary exercise contrast
HFD vs NC (S2.6.p1, Fig. 6B; paper: 2,746 DEGs) - diet model check, not an exercise effect
HAE vs HRE (S2.6.p1, Fig. 6E; paper: 625 DEGs) - exercise-modality comparison
selected.repeated_measure_unit: none; one liver per mouse, independent animals
selected.paper_method: DESeq2 1.40.1 pairwise group comparisons (S4.5.p1); exact design formula and whether each pair was fitted separately not stated

paper_threshold.note: text reads 'log2FC < 1 and a p-value < 1E-2'; interpreted as |log2FC| > 1 and raw p < 0.01 (the literal 'log2FC < 1' cannot define DEGs that include up-regulated genes, and the paper reports up- and down-regulated DEGs)

paper_results.named_genes: exercise-upregulated Hsd3b5, Cyp4a12b, Slco1a1; downregulated Cd8b1, Cidea, Ccl7, Sprr1a; Sit1 down in HAE, Slc7a11 down in HRE (S2.7.p1, S4.p1)
paper_results.pathways: KEGG up in HAE vs HFD: retinol metabolism, arachidonic acid metabolism, bile secretion, fatty acid degradation; up in HRE vs HFD: PPAR signaling, unsaturated FA biosynthesis, FA metabolism (S2.6.p2)

decisions.reason: Results S2.6.p1 lists four liver RNA-seq comparisons with DEG counts; methods S4.5.p1 give DESeq2 and the threshold; DA.p1 names GSE286570. The exercise estimand is each exercise arm versus the sedentary HFD arm; HFD vs NC is the disease-model contrast and HAE vs HRE compares modalities.

checks: DA.p1 names GSE286570 as the transcriptomic deposit
GEO tissue = Liver, organism Mus musculus, matches S2.6.p1 liver RNA-seq
GEO groups NC/HFD/HFD+AE/HFD+RE match the paper's four groups
data_processing text (Fastp params, HISAT2 mm10, featureCounts vM25, DESeq2 1.40.1) is verbatim the paper's S4.5.p1
contact Mingliang Wei, Wuhan University = paper author who did RNA-seq analysis (BK1.p1)

decisions.reason: Paper and GEO series agree on accession, tissue, groups and processing pipeline.

inspect alignment_keys: matrix columns (H-AE1) equal metadata title (H-AE-1) after separator normalization, 12/12. Group from characteristics treatment (identical to the 'genotype' field), recoded to the paper's labels.

candidates: raw_counts (confirm against provenance: normalized integers and rounded estimated counts look the same)

decisions.reason: integer_fraction 1.0, max 7.6e6, featureCounts layout (Geneid, Chr, Start, End, Strand, Length + 12 sample columns); GEO data_processing: 'table-delimited txt file includes raw counts for each samples'. Matches the paper's DESeq2 input.

Four independent groups, n=3 each, one factor. Exercise effect = HAE vs HFD and HRE vs HFD (both on HFD background, sedentary HFD reference) per S2.6.p1. HFD vs NC (diet) and HAE vs HRE (modality) are the paper's other two comparisons, kept as secondary. One DESeq2 model on all 12 samples with planned contrasts, not pooled exercise arms. The diet comparison is extracted as NC vs HFD in the model (HFD reference); its DEG count is sign-symmetric to the paper's HFD vs NC.
One liver per independent mouse; no batch, lane, or sex variation recorded (all male, S4.1.1.p1); no blocking unit.

selected.method: DESeq2 (pydeseq2 Wald), one model ~ grp on all 12 samples

paper_route.reason: pydeseq2 Wald test reproduces DESeq2; the paper does not say whether each pair was fitted separately, so pairwise two-group fits are run as sensitivity

deviations: joint 4-group model (shared dispersion) rather than possibly separate pairwise fits; pairwise fits run as sensitivity

decisions.reason: Raw counts support the paper's DESeq2 route directly.

selected.deviation_note: Paper text 'log2FC < 1 and p-value < 1E-2' read as |log2FC| > 1 and raw p < 0.01 (typo). Raw p, as stated; BH padj < 0.05 reported as audit. Audit rule changed to BH padj < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1: the closest-matching rule for HRE vs HFD (paper 171), reported next to the paper rule; the paper's raw-p rule stays primary.

decisions.reason: S4.5.p1 threshold, applied exactly as interpreted; raw p kept as the paper states it.

caveats: GEO holds 3 livers per group while the paper's animal groups are n=8 (NC n=13); the RNA-seq n is not stated in the text, so 3/group is assumed to be what the paper sequenced
n=3 per group: DEG counts at raw p < 0.01 are sensitive to the model (joint vs pairwise dispersion)
threshold text in S4.5.p1 is internally inconsistent ('log2FC < 1'); interpretation recorded
HRE vs HFD: paper's 171 matches BH padj<0.05 & |log2FC|>1 (our audit count), not the stated raw p<0.01 & |log2FC|>1 (our 467); the paper's applied rule for this contrast is uncertain

decisions.reason: Paper-aligned DESeq2 on the paper's deposited counts and comparisons with the paper's threshold.
